name: local-channels
description: Local channel plugins for this host

plugins.name: local-webhook
plugins.description: HMAC-verified webhook channel: pushes deliveries from GitHub or any other signing sender into the session, plus webhook_subscribe / webhook_unsubscribe MCP tools (and an equivalent webhook.py CLI) for topic routing — including deliver_to:"subagent" standing watches that spawn a fresh session per event batch instead of interrupting the active one, and per-subscription include/exclude payload predicates so routing can key on event content, not just topic and sender, and a per-watch `spawnConfig` handed to the spawn command so two watches on one repo can start different workers. `webhook.py emit` puts box-local events (budget, disk, OOM) on the same bus. Claude Code sessions receive it as a channel; codex sessions receive the same deliveries through a detached peer that hands each one over with `codex queue`.
